description: Ministry of Ports and Shipping - Merchant Shipping (Tonnage Measurement of Ships) Regulations No. 10 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping under the Merchant Shipping Act, establishing legal/regulatory frameworks for tonnage measurement of ships. It implements an international convention, outlines certification requirements, inspection procedures, and compliance measures. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather on establishing legal/regulatory requirements for maritime operations.
